title: Import HTML Slides (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Import HTML Slides applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Import HTML Slides (BtnHtmlSlideImport) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: HTML import pipeline boundaries are pinned by the production Core tests
scenarios.expected: The host-free HTML import pipeline parses supported AI-generated presentation HTML into slide models (sections with slide classes, entity-decoded text, footer spans), strips script/canvas/video content, enforces the documented limits (HTML byte cap with HtmlImportLimitException) and never executes JavaScript; these behaviors are already driven by the production HtmlPipelineBoundaryTests (17 tests) used by HtmlPresentationImportService, so this scenario binds the existing runner instead of duplicating it.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
